lyrics:
[Intro: slow synth swell, distant guitar notes, water]

[Verse 1: airy female voice, very quiet]
I learned to swim in the shallow end
Toes on the tile, one hand on the edge
I liked a floor that I could feel
I liked a wall. I liked a deal.

[Verse 2: a little fuller, a soft pulse begins]
Then you were standing where the water's dark
Past the rope, past the last white mark
You didn't shout, you didn't wave
You just said my name, and "come," and stayed

[Chorus: wide and soaring, soft drums enter]
So I'm out past the buoys now
Out where my feet can't find the ground
Everything I trusted is back on the sand
All I've got is your voice and your hand
More afraid and more alive than I knew how
Out past the buoys now

[Verse 3: voice close again, guitar notes ringing]
A fisherman did this, long before me
Climbed out of a boat on a midnight sea
He walked till he looked at the wind instead
Went under, reached, and you were there. You said

[Bridge: slow build, layered voices, growing each line]
"Why did you doubt? I had you."
"Why did you doubt? I had you."
I had you. I have you.
I had you. I have you.
Jesus, you have me

[Final Chorus: full drums, soaring, voices stacked]
So I'm out past the buoys now
Out where my feet can't find the ground
Everything I trusted is back on the sand
All I've got is your voice and your hand
More afraid and more alive than I knew how
Out past the buoys now

[Outro: synths fade into water, one breath]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 66 BPM, 4/4, D major. Very slow and weightless, building in one long arc.

VOICE: Female soprano, young, airy and pure, with a lot of breath. She barely sings above a murmur until the chorus, then opens out. In the bridge her voice is layered again and again until it is a crowd.

INSTRUMENTS: Warm synth pads, an electric guitar with long delay playing single notes, a soft sub-bass pulse, piano, toms and a slow kick from the first chorus, full drums and cymbal swells only at the end, water sounds.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, pads and water. 0:20 Verse 1. 0:48 Verse 2, pulse begins. 1:18 Chorus 1. 1:56 Verse 3, the fisherman. 2:26 Bridge, building line by line. 3:04 Final chorus, full. 3:40 Outro, fade to water and a breath at 3:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Cinematic dream pop: huge reverb, wide pads, the voice floating in front, drums far away until the end.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The fourth 'I have you' in the bridge at 2:50, when the full drums finally arrive.

THE REVEAL: Two verses and a chorus read as a love song or a swimming lesson. Verse 3 at 1:56 is Peter leaving the boat in Matthew 14. The bridge gives Christ's own words to him, and then the name.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Caution, called, out of depth, held.
